influences.name: The Comedian Harmonists
influences.context: I started by studying what they did. They only had about 20 recordings at the time. And they were great, they knocked me out.

influences.name: Sheldon Harnick
influences.context: Bruce and I need that before we start…what we're writing about. [In context of discussion about Fiddler on the Roof and Sheldon Harnick's work as lyricist]

influences.name: Jerome Robbins
influences.context: It was Jerome Robbins who said, 'Ah, I know what this show is about', and the show was already up at that point. [In context of Barry and Bruce discussing how they approach their work]

influences.name: Oscar Hammerstein
influences.context: And…what did Oscar Hammerstein say? [Referencing Hammerstein's philosophy about writing for oneself and the audience]

influences.name: Clive Davis
influences.context: But I'm not really good at this; it's Clive Davis' brainchild.
